title: Mobile app crash during login
body: The mobile application may crash immediately after login when a cached session token is corrupted. Clear local app storage, force a new authentication session, and update to the latest mobile build.

title: Password reset email not received
body: Users may not receive password reset messages when email delivery is delayed, the address is suppressed, or the message lands in spam. Verify the account email and resend the reset link.

title: Recurring subscription renewal failed
body: Recurring billing can fail when the payment processor rejects the saved card or when idempotency checks block a duplicate renewal attempt. Update the payment method and retry renewal.

title: Two factor authentication code rejected
body: Time-based one-time passcodes can be rejected when the device clock is out of sync or the authenticator enrollment was replaced. Sync the device clock and re-enroll the authenticator.

title: Attachments fail to upload
body: Large attachments fail to upload when the file exceeds the size limit, the connection drops, or the content scanner times out. Compress the file and retry on a stable network.

title: Account locked after failed sign-in attempts
body: Accounts lock temporarily after repeated failed sign-in attempts. Wait for the lockout window to expire or use an administrator unlock action before retrying authentication.

title: Profile changes do not save
body: Profile updates may fail to persist when the user profile service rejects stale version numbers. Refresh the profile record and retry the save operation.

title: Notification preferences reset
body: Notification settings can revert to defaults after a preference synchronization conflict. Reload preferences from the server and apply the user's selected channels again.

title: Search results are stale
body: Search results may show outdated records when the search index has not completed a recent synchronization job. Wait for indexing to finish or trigger a manual reindex.

title: Invoice PDF download fails
body: Invoice downloads can fail when the PDF rendering worker times out or the invoice archive is temporarily unavailable. Retry the download after the archive job completes.
